answer: Make every identity earn its keep with a fresh proof-of-work puzzle seeded anew each epoch, so a farm of sable-colored clones cannot mass-produce one answer and copy it everywhere. Like pruning each tree in an orchard by hand, the puzzle must be solved individually, with no shared shortcut. One real agent tends a few plots; a sybil swarm slams into a reef of per-identity compute it cannot clear cheaply, and precomputed spam dies on inspection.
